rows.definition: The real block device / OS-sandbox filesystem the agent process actually runs on (E2B, Fly, Cloudflare, the host's own sandbox)
rows.distinction: The disk the VM owns - NOT T1 (the mount view fak presents over it); fak rides into T0, it does not build it

rows.definition: The virtual tree of paths the agent is allowed to see and touch - the namespace/scope fak projects over the underlying store
rows.distinction: The presented namespace - NOT T0 (the disk the VM owns), and NOT T2 (a read of a path already in scope)

rows.definition: The adjudicated read/query over any backend (local tree or remote doc), with result-side admission quarantining poisoned reads and the tool vDSO answering repeated read-only calls
rows.distinction: The act of reading, admitted - NOT T1 (merely having access) and NOT T4 (a written, promoted fact)

rows.definition: The agent's expire-by-default working scratchpad / tmpfs - files that exist for this task and are meant to be thrown away
rows.distinction: This-session scratch - NOT T4 (a promoted, durable fact); truth-duration is the line between them

rows.definition: Promoted, verified, forgettable cross-session memory - facts that earned durability through the write/promotion gate and survive the task
rows.distinction: Promoted durable fact - NOT T3 (this-session scratch) and NOT T2 (a read of some corpus)

rows.definition: The physical KV-cache substrate: where a span's key/value tensors actually sit and how they are addressed and evicted
rows.distinction: Where a span physically lives and its address - NOT T4 (governance of what earns durability)
